done_when: forge close opens a blocked pull request as a draft and marks it ready for review once its review is clean and its checks are green

findings.body: The test creates a blocked draft, but its next close dismisses the blocking finding immediately. Every other existing-draft case also has a clean review. Consequently, moving the check wait and promotion before the serious-finding refusal could promote a still-blocked draft while these tests continue passing. Before dismissing the finding, retry close with the existing draft and green checks; assert that close refuses and issues no `pr ready` command. This covers the negative half of the explicit clean-review requirement.
findings.title: Not done: a draft stays draft while its review remains blocked

why: A pull request whose review is still blocked looks mergeable on GitHub
